title: OLD BUG : Activate/Deactivate pod buttons are lit
body:
This bug was solved but is back once more. **Both** pod _activate_ and _deactivate_ buttons are turned ON (lit, not grayed) all the time (when pod is activated and when no pod is activated).

![Screenshot_20220414-114908_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/163449834-3cff993a-b65a-4b7a-8a8a-51f96bafd7e1.jpg)

![Screenshot_20220414-194704_AndroidAPS.jpg](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/76626474/163449853-6dd8642c-c736-4f13-904c-dceadb245b99.jpg)
